tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Deputy Commissioner-C of State Tax, Business Audit Wing-VI, Jaipur, Rajasthan had passed the demand order dated 27/02/2025 amounting to Rs. 4.92 crore, alleging wrong reduction of tax liability on account of rate difference credit notes under section 15(3)(b) of RGST/CGST Act, 2017 during the period April 2020 to March 2021.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner-C, Business Audit Wing VI, Jaipur, Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed an appeal before the Appellate Authority, State Tax, Udaipur. The Appellate Authority, State Tax, Udaipur vide its Order dated 19/05/2026 had confirmed the demand order dated 27/02/2025. The Company has filed a Rectification Application No. ZD080626040810G dt. 12/06/2026 before Appellate Authority. After rectification, the Company will challenge the said Order before the appropriate Authority.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Demand order passed amounting to Rs. 4.60 crore under Section 4 and 21 of the MMDR Act, 1957 pertaining to non-compliance with certain conditions of the mining lease and alleged unauthorized mining activities carried out in a protected/restricted area (‘Bheelo ka Devra’).
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Mining Engineer, Department of Mines & Geology, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed an appeal before the Hon'ble High Court, Jodhpur. The Hon'ble High Court, Jodhpur vide its Order dated 22/05/2026 has granted a stay on the demand order dated 13/04/2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Commissioner, Central Goods and Services Tax and Central Excise, Bolpur, vide Order-in-Original (OIO) dated 26/06/2019, confirmed the demand of Rs. 282.06 lakh out of the total demand of Rs. 463.29 lakh, along with applicable interest and penalty, on account of disallowance of CENVAT credit availed on Sales Commission for the period from July 2013 to March 2017. Aggrieved by the confirmed demand, the Company filed an appeal before the Hon’ble CESTAT, Kolkata, on 14/10/2019.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: The Commissioner of Central Goods and Services Tax & Central Excise, Jamshedpur Commissionerate
tax_litigation.status: The Hon’ble Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal (CESTAT), Kolkata, vide Order No. FO/A/75892/2026-EX[DB] dated 15/07/2026, has allowed the CENVAT credit on Sales Commission, thereby accepting the Company's contentions and submissions. Accordingly, the demand relating to the disallowance of CENVAT credit on Sales Commission has been decided in favour of the Company.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Deputy Commissioner-C of State Tax, Business Audit Wing-VI, Jaipur, Rajasthan had passed the demand order dated 27/02/2025 amounting to Rs. 4.92 crore, alleging wrong reduction of tax liability on account of rate difference credit notes under section 15(3)(b) of RGST/CGST Act, 2017 during the period April 2020 to March 2021.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Deputy Commissioner-C, Business Audit Wing VI, Jaipur, Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: The Company had filed an appeal before the Appellate Authority, State Tax, Udaipur. The Appellate Authority, State Tax, Udaipur vide its Order dated 19/05/2026 had confirmed the demand order dated 27/02/2025. The Company had filed a Rectification Application No. ZD080626040810G dated 12/06/2026 before Appellate Authority. The said application was rejected vide order dated 27/08/2026. The Company has filed an appeal before the Goods and Services Tax Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT). The matter is currently pending adjudication before the GSTAT.

guidance.statement: We are going to take capacity up to 27.5 million tons by financial year '29.

industry: Commodities > Construction Materials > Cement & Cement Products

operating_notes.text: Received penalty of ₹4.61 Cr from Department of Mines & Geology, Chittorgarh for alleged mining outside restricted areas; legal appeal underway.
Commenced mining operations at Bikram Coal Mine with annual capacity of 9.44 Million Tonnes.
Bikram Coal Mine has extractable reserves of 9.44 Million Tonnes and peak rated capacity of 0.36 MTPA.
RCCPL Private Limited commissioned the third line at its Kundanganj grinding unit, adding 1.4 million tonnes of cement capacity.
Capacity utilization for FY26 reached 95% against an estimated industry average of around 70%.
Annual production capacity increased to 21.4 MT following the commissioning of Kundanganj Line III in March.
Blended cement share reached 88% and trade segment share reached 77% in FY26.

timeline.summary: On April 22, 2026, Birla Corporation disclosed a ₹4.61 Cr mining penalty order from the Department of Mines & Geology, Chittorgarh, which it plans to challenge.
Birla Corporation commenced commercial mining operations at the Bikram Coal Mine with a 9.44 MTPA capacity.
On April 23, 2026, Birla Corporation issued a corrigendum clarifying Bikram Coal Mine extractable reserves at 9.44 Million Tonnes and peak capacity at 0.36 MTPA.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,836.12 Cr (+0.8% YoY), net profit ₹294.77 Cr (+14.9% YoY).
Birla Corporation reported FY26 net profit of ₹558 Cr on record cement sales of 18.72 MT and expanded capacity to 21.4 MTPA.
Birla Corporation filed the audio recording link for its Q4FY26 earnings conference call.
ICRA reaffirmed Birla Corporation's AA (stable) rating on its two NCD ISINs on 8 May 2026, intimated to exchanges on 11 May 2026.
Birla Corporation held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 11, 2026, outlining its calibrated capacity expansion to 27.5 MTPA by FY29.
Vindhya Telelinks Limited, as Promoter of Birla Corporation Limited, declared no encumbrance on its 8.29% stake and subsidiaries’ shares for FY2025-26 on **2026-04-04** under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
